findings.summary: The attached rendered PNG shows the sweep bars and event dots with no visible event names, row labels, or time scale. A reader cannot tell which sweep or duty each mark represents, so the figure cannot communicate the timing evidence without relying on its caption.

raw_text:
RUBRIC legibility: fail — the 1400 × 720 PNG contains lines and dots but no visible labels or time scale, so the sequence cannot be read at a glance
RUBRIC data_ink: pass — simple lines and event dots carry the visible data; there are no gradients or decorative fills
RUBRIC decoration: pass — the transparent canvas has no visible background fill, gradient, or decorative styling
RUBRIC contrast: fail — no text is visible in the PNG, leaving its event names and time values unreadable; the green and grey marks themselves are discernible
RUBRIC table_form: pass — an event timeline is a useful graphical form for the relative timing described in the caption
RUBRIC label_collision: fail — event, row, and time labels are absent from the rendered PNG, so the reader cannot identify the bars or dots
